# Exp Fit Intvl

[All examples](index.md) · [Document profile](../reference/studio-draft-examples.md)

Inspect the confidence bounds when the sample follows the supplied exponential model exactly. The zero residual makes both bounds coincide with its fitted values.

## What this example demonstrates

Inspect the confidence bounds when the sample follows the supplied exponential model exactly. The zero residual makes both bounds coincide with its fitted values.
